title: G03: citation/obligation ledger and proposed verified bibliography (refs #59)
body:
## Result and scope

Refs #59 (G03), parent #26.

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/59#issuecomment-6841662484, session `ADB991-claude-20261113-20f1`
- Outputs: `blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/G03/` (README, ledger, findings, proposed-patches, validation, handoff) and the proposed `manuscript/existence/verified-references.tex` (not `\input` anywhere; F01 decides integration). No chapter, preamble or `existence.tex` edit.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

G03 author pass 1, at basis `d3c7a19`. It inventories every external literature invocation in the 241 included chapters. There are 11 explicit references (5 bibitems, plus inline footnotes for Jaffard, Hall, Krantz–Parks and Tropp) and about 20 named standard results used without citation. For each reference the ledger records its use, whether it is load-bearing, whether its hypotheses hold in the application, and who checked the source and where.

**Established.** No load-bearing citation is misapplied. Hall's two facts used in `lem:branch-nearest-projection` are now verified against arXiv:math-ph/0005032v1 (Def. 2.2 p. 9, Thm 3.6 p. 32, Def. 3.13 p. 36, Thm 3.23 p. 44).

**Findings (F1–F8):**
- F1: the Williams bibitem carries one theorem's locator for three uses; this closes C04 review M9.
- F2: the OS75 page range should point at the named theorem on p. 287, and the Summers appendix should be credited.
- F3: Hall 2015, Krantz–Parks, the BHV PDF and Jaffard have never been independently checked against the source.
- F4: the SNAG dual-group identification is not cited.
- F5: the monograph does not attribute the Lean source or Armstrong's map, and does not cite Wilson.
- F6: the Tropp reference is incomplete.
- F7: the stated reader prerequisites omit complex analysis, Bochner integration, Hahn–Banach and the Gaussian inequalities.
- F8: some references sit in footnotes or inline text and would not reach any bibliography.

Patches P1–P6 for the owning packages and F01 are proposed in the report, not applied.

**Uncertain or open.** Every non-arXiv host was unreachable from this sandbox, so the book locators (Hall 2015, Krantz–Parks) and the BHV PDF remain unverified. There are no historical claims yet: Section 2 (G04, #60) does not exist, so the historical part must be re-run against it.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: Lean `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464` (no Lean read; no citation points into Lean). Manuscript basis `codex/existence-monograph` @ `d3c7a1901390f4821d4b91f6f639bb5c60c63604`.
- Commands actually run and results:
  - `python3 scripts/check_blueprint.py`: Blueprint structure OK.
  - `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`: 22 OK.
  - `git diff --check`: clean.
  - `pdflatex` wrapper citing all nine keys and inputting `verified-references.tex`: exit 0 with no warnings; the rendered list was inspected.
  - The arXiv PDF of Hall was downloaded and read with `pdftotext`.
  - Searches, access failures and SHA-256 values are in `results/G03/validation.md`.
- Checks not performed and why: the full `existence.tex` build was not run, because no chapter changed and the new file is not input. No Lean commands were run, because none were needed. Visual checks of non-arXiv sources were blocked by the network allowlist.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: none to mathematics. The proposed patches touch files owned by C02, C04, C06, C07, C16 and F01.

## Review and handoff

- [x] The scope matches the task and has no duplicate declaration ownership.
- [x] Source citations and hypotheses have been checked, where applicable (with the stated access limits).
- [x] Applicable literature results were sought; substantive steps have detailed proofs or verified references. (audit only)
- [x] Structural checks pass.
- [x] Draft/reviewed status is accurate; stale reviews were cleared or renewed.
- [x] The issue has a handoff and links to any durable Bots notes.

Required next review: independent review of the G03 ledger (inventory completeness, application verdicts, locators), ideally by someone with access to the books in F3. Not by an ADB991 session.
